verdict.rationale: Amplitude Experiment documents staging features for beta testers and targeting audiences by properties, cohorts, or segments. That suggests a group of specific users can be targeted. Nothing in the evidence explicitly shows adding individual user IDs to a flag or excluding specific users. missing for 10: explicit individual user/device ID targeting (allowlist), explicit exclusion/blocklist of specific users, internal-account targeting docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can target or exclude specific individual users for a flag (allowlists, beta testers, internal accounts)

citations.quote: Pre-plan and stage new features for beta testers, a percentage of your users, or specific target audiences.
to target users by properties, cohorts, or segments.
